[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-q5[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Snoozed Tasks: plan it for today, wake it at a time[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bryan can snooze any open, non-Event task to a clock time today [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from its Task Link, its definition, capture, or the CLI. While [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]asleep the task is clearly marked with a clock and its time, stays [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]out of Today, the walks, and plan.max_links. At its time, bob wakes[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]it into an untimed open Pomodoro, the woken Task Link shows its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]wake time, and one hard-to-miss notice announces it and then goes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]away on its own.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]snoozed_tasks.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/snoozed_tasks.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-q5[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-q5/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]

    [#D7D7AF]bob snooze list/add/drop/wake CLI with guarded writes, never-running [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wake placement, struck history rows, the first-position tick step, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wake receipt plus Darwin post plus desktop fallback, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]trailing-section writer audit, shared vectors, and docs/snooze.md.[/#D7D7AF]
